scores.tell: Books have smooth, soft form turn but the tabletop has a glossy lavender sheen and a painterly, soft-focus look. Shadows are gentle and slightly muddy.
none. The soft rim light, the broad sheen and the leather's gentle form turn match the real saddle.
Keys and body are well modeled with a soft sheen. The soft glow around the calculator is slightly strong, and the screen highlight is a little flat.
The stone has soft, uniform shading and a mild cast shadow. The form turn is a bit flat and the grass lacks the real cards' deep shadow pools. It reads as a painterly illustration.
The dome has banded, glossy blue facets. The crater and ground have lots of small texture noise. The shadow is faint and the shading is busy.
none. The hat has a smooth, soft form turn and a broad sheen. The cast shadow is gentle, as on the real cards.
The cauldron is painterly, with textured, grimy shading and a scruffy background. The glow from the fire is only loosely modeled, and the pot has little light or form turn.
The trunk and leaves have smooth, soft form turns. The sand cast shadow is crisp and the leaf highlights are slightly glossy.
The cauldron has glossy highlights on the rim and the bubbles. The dark body has a fairly flat form turn. The cast shadow is soft.
The metal tubes have crisp, sharp highlights, and the chair's cast shadow is crisp. The fabric has fine texture. The overall light is good.
